text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. During this period,
we had to find a way to nurse Manhattan Cafe's body back to health
after being tormented by numerous paranormal phenomena.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Regardless of such determination...
the Umamusume were in high spirits upon arriving at the training camp."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... I'm really looking forward to the training camp... Where should we go?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a deserted cliff? Yeah, a forgotten cave
deep in the mountains might be nice too. Heheheh...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-Who are you talking to, Cafe~!?
*shiver-shiver-shiver*!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... I don't really get it,
but just being around is kind of spooky...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, it's more like a mystery than a horror story. Don't you think, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
An invisible unknown is much harder to deal with than a visible monster.
I don't want anyone getting in my way. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Rather than who they are, I'm more curious
about what they're trying to do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The "friend." We know far too little about that mysterious presence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Normally there's neither the time nor leeway to delve deeply,but perhaps during summer training camp...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
……? Is something the matter, Trainer?
You're staring right at me.
choice_data_list: Let's talk about all sorts of things this summer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Understanding it more deeply would surely be one way to find an improvement.
That's what I felt.
